## Change

Describe the user or contributor problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks run, their results, and any acceptance checks still pending.

- [ ] Command, installation, and supported-feature changes are reflected in all three READMEs and the relevant guides, or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] New fixtures or model assets have provenance and licenses; the change contains no credentials, user media, or private operational data.
